term: proportional description and threshold possibility in Physics VII.5
definition: The chapter compares specified whole, half and double agents, affected objects and elapsed times within a stated proportional setup. Its later qualification permits a halved alterer or grower to produce no change in some case. In the current encoding, doubling/halving descriptions are primitive propositions, and HalfAltererAltersIn/HalfGrowerGrowsIn are predicates on cases. Existential failure cases do not mean every halved agent fails or encode physical possibility by a modal logic.
note: An explicit account of the existing reading interface, not a new mechanics model. A model of measured degrees, sizes, durations and causal thresholds would be needed before attributing numerical dynamics to these proposition parameters.
